capabilities: Import Marvin categories, projects, and tasks into managed note regions
Create Marvin tasks from the editor with deep links back to the source note
Mark linked Marvin tasks done when checklist items are checked in Obsidian
Refresh a managed Today region in daily notes with due and scheduled tasks
Expose a typed API for Templater automation and a local MCP server for agents
extras: Distributed via BRAT or manual file copy rather than the community store; sync is mostly one-way (Marvin is the source of truth) with deliberate exceptions for task creation and completion; the bundled MCP server is stated to be spun out into its own repository; an experimental incremental sync feature exists; the local desktop API can be used to avoid API rate limits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view Amazing Marvin task data in notes or create and complete Marvin tasks from the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin brings Amazing Marvin tasks, categories, and projects into Obsidian
The link can use either Advanced URI (the default, for the Advanced URI community plugin)
The default projection remains the existing Dataview format.
tasks can instead use Obsidian Tasks' Dataview fields or emoji date format
Templater and other in-Obsidian automation can use a typed API

requires.name: Amazing Marvin desktop app (local API server)

summary: Amazing Marvin integration that imports tasks, categories, and projects into vault notes, creates and completes Marvin tasks, and ships a companion MCP server.
